column1: # Tolbi, after Ash Jenna: Mia admits that Ash Jenna's taunts unsettled her.

column3: She saw you afraid.\nShe didn't see you\nstand up again.{end_wait}
What she said hurt.\nBecause part of it\nwas true.{end_wait}
But you told us.\nWe know what happened.\nAnd we're still here.{end_wait}
Then I'll keep going.\nNot to prove her wrong.\nThere's work left to do.{end_wait}
